create_tensorboard_writer: create a TensorboardWriter instance that wraps SummaryWriter for logging to a specified directory
create_wandb_writer: create a WeightsAndBiasesWriter instance that initializes wandb logging with project and run configuration
get_writer_from_config: get a logging writer by config type returning either TensorboardWriter or WeightsAndBiasesWriter
add_video_from_np_images: add a video to tensorboard from a list of numpy array image frames at a given step
add_scalars_to_wandb: add multiple scalar metrics to wandb under a log group with a specified step id
